description: Open-source browser agent that found a real Google Flights result (Zurich to London) in 7.1s for $0.0039.
how_used_jev: Jev picks the next browser action (CLICK, TYPE_TEXT, SELECT, SCROLL, WAIT, DONE, BLOCKED) and target element index from the indexed DOM each step; a small LLM only runs when the action is TYPE_TEXT.
author: @gregpr07

benchmark.task: Zurich -> London flight search on real Google Flights
